name: OMOPHub Healthcare Vocabulary API
description: A comprehensive healthcare vocabulary API platform providing secure, compliant access to medical terminologies and OHDSI vocabulary services. CPT4 access requires the API-key owner to complete annual UMLS validation in the OMOPHub Dashboard and expires each January 30 UTC. Unlicensed direct or CPT4-only requests return 403 vocabulary_restricted; mixed search filters omit CPT4 and return accessible vocabularies. GPI and MedDRA remain unavailable.
